{{Quote|Ah well. You know what they say: You can't see Kuat until you've seen Horthav.|[[Shandy Fanaso]], to [[Mactimentus]]|<ref name="DTM">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/triton20080820.html|text="Deader than a Triton Moon"|int=Deader than a Triton Moon|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>}}
'''Horthav''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

==History==
The Horthav system served as a staging area for [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] heading to the [[Kuat Freight Port]].<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref> As a result, it was commonly said that you had to see Horthav before you could see [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].<ref name="DTM" />
